Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Igbo, in Divine Voice™ Color — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Igbo Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Nke a bụ Baịbụl mbụ e biri ebi nke na-egosi gị onye na-ekwu okwu. Okwu Nna anyị nʼagba anụnụ anụnụ, okwu Ọkpara nʼagba ọbara ọbara, okwu Mmụọ nʼagba ododo.

Ihe karịrị narị afọ, mkpụrụedemede ọbara ọbara egosila ebe Ọkpara na-ekwu okwu. Ma Nna anyị na-ekwu okwu karịa nke ahụ — nʼime Baịbụl Igbo a, okwu 140,106 nʼime amaokwu 5,609 — ma ruo ugbu a, e biri okwu ya niile nʼotu agba oji ahụ e ji bipụta usoro ọmụmụ. Ọ nọ na-ekwu okwu oge niile; ọ dịghị Baịbụl gosiri gị ebe ọ na-ekwu okwu.
Agba bụ akara nwe, ọ bụghị akara nhota. Okwu Nna anyị ka bụ nke ya, nʼọnụ onye ọbụla ji ikwesị ntụkwasị obi bufee ya; a naghị etinye agba nʼokwu ọ na-ekwubeghị; akụkọ ka dị oji.

Mgbe ndị na-eso ụzọ jụrụ otú ha ga-esi kpee ekpere, Ọkpara enyeghị ha usoro okwu. O nyere ha Nna: “Nna anyị nke bi nʼeluigwe, ka e doo aha gị nsọ” (Matiu 6:9). Ihe niile dị nʼime Baịbụl a sitere nʼotu okwu ahụ. Site na Mmụọ, anyị na-eti mkpu, sị, “Abba! Nna!” (Ndị Rom 8:15).

Ọ nọghị nʼebe dị anya. Obi ya adaghị mba nʼebe ị nọ. Ọ bụ Nna gị nke eluigwe, ị bụkwa nwa ya ọ hụrụ nʼanya. Ọ bụrụ na okwu ahụ bụ ‘nna’ anaghị enye gị nkasiobi, Baịbụl a bụ nke gị karịsịa: Nna e gosiri nʼime peeji ndị a abụghị onyinyo nke ịbụ nna mmadụ mebiri emebi, kama ọ bụ onye ezinụlọ ọbụla nʼeluigwe na nʼụwa si nʼaka ya nweta aha ya.

Baịbụl zuru ezu nʼotu mpịakọta — akwụkwọ 66, isi 1,189, amaokwu 31,087; ọ dịghị ihe e wepụrụ. Okwu mmeghe nʼakwụkwọ ọbụla, ihe ndetu 1,361 maka onye na-agụ ya, ọ bụghị maka onye nchọcha, na peeji nraranye maka aha onye ị na-enye ya.

Ntụgharị kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi site na Hibru, Aramaik na Grik mbụ; a sụgharịrị mbipụta ọbụla site na Father's Heart Bible™. Nha 6 x 9 inch, mkpuchi dị nro na mkpuchi siri ike, e biri ya nʼagba. Onyinye, ncheta, ihe nketa.
Maka ezinụlọ Igbo ọbụla na nzukọ ọbụla — nʼala Igbo, nʼofe Naịjirịa niile na gburugburu ụwa — ka ha nụ olu Nna nʼasụsụ nke ha.
Nabata Nna gị. Nụrụ olu ya. Obi ya dịịrị gị.

Divine Voice Color: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE
A presentation page — a gift, and a keepsake worth handing on
Paperback and hardcover, 6 x 9, full color throughout

faq.q: Is the Igbo edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Igbo, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Igbo edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Igbo edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Igbo text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Igbo Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/ig.
